title: RateHarbor Blog: Hotel and Airbnb Pricing Guides
description: The RateHarbor blog: guides for independent hotels and Airbnb hosts on break-even pricing, rate strategy, OTA commission costs, fees and policy changes.
heading: RateHarbor Blog
intro: Guides for independent hotel owners and Airbnb hosts on room pricing, OTA listings and rate parity.

blocks.heading: Who the RateHarbor Blog Is For
paragraphs: The blog covers room pricing, OTA listings, rate parity and performance reporting for owners of independent hotels, small hotel groups and other lodging properties, drawing on our remote revenue management and OTA management work.

We [work with independent hotels and small hotel groups](/about-us/) in many countries, including the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and Australia. You can take these services and our related online services separately or together. We don't run your hotel operations.
We [work only remotely](/our-process/). We use your hotel's own systems and online accounts, and we have no staff on site at any property.

blocks.heading: Ready to Talk Pricing? Send RateHarbor an Enquiry
paragraphs: Send us an [enquiry](/contact-us/) to talk about pricing for your property. We’ll reply within one business day.
